post:

headline: Rare Mego Green Goblin Crushes Estimates
post:
Hey Spider-Man fans! A truly legendary piece of vintage toy history is making waves right now. According to ComicBook.com, a rare graded 1975 Mego Green Goblin action figure has already blown past expectations with weeks of bidding still left to go. 

Originally given a conservative estimate of $30,000 to $50,000, this incredible collectible has already reached a staggering $90,000 in the current Hakes auction. It has already beaten the previous 2022 record sale of $76,700 for a Mego action figure. Experts report that this makes it "poised to be the first-ever Mego action figure to sell for more than $100k." 📦

Driven by its rare plastic bubble and cardback packaging alongside an AFA certified 80+ Near Mint condition, this piece of Spider-Man history is nearly one of a kind. It proves just how much these classic Marvel toys still mean to collectors today!

Who is your favorite Mego action figure?

#SpiderMan #GreenGoblin #MegoToys
original_title: Record-Breaking Mego Green Goblin Has Already Blown Past Hakes Price Estimates (And There’s Still Weeks Left to Bid)
